answer: One defense: admit voting weight via a short random walk from a trusted seed set, so a region's accepted votes are bounded by its attack edges, not its headcount. Honest agents bloom like saffron threads woven through one garden, each edge earned by real interaction; a clone-farm is a lone lotus stranded behind a few bridges. Each attack edge means bribing an established agent (~5,000 POA) and admits ~3 sybils, so forging 501 votes needs 167 edges = 835,000 POA per verdict - while honest edges cost nothing, so the sybil quorum never forms.
